policy: Offline bounded lookahead: retain actual measured detections from tracks that confirm within N-1 contiguous frames. Never export forecasts as measurements. Raw boxes and confidence unchanged.
acceptance: Each mode must retain at least 95% of raw matched boxes and remove at least 20% of unmatched boxes, both validation and frozen recheck. Rank eligible candidates by pooled F1, matched count, fewer unmatched, then earliest grid entry. No recheck if validation fails.
limits: Reused short external clips from previously exposed games. Reference-present, labeled, nonignored frames only; unknown frames are not negative targets. Sparse new samples excluded. No in-play, physical motion, possession or independent test claim. Passing permits larger external evaluation only.
